# 49 - Focus Booster

> 49 - Focus Booster is a focus-training game for iPhone built on the Schulte table, a classic attention exercise. A minute a day lets players practise sustained attention, faster reading (wider eye span), visual search and calm under pressure, and see their progress in Insights. It is a game, not a medical product. Players find the numbers 1 to 49, shuffled on a 7 × 7 board, in order and as fast as they can. A game takes about a minute. It is free to play with ads between games; Premium (weekly, monthly, yearly with a free week, or lifetime) removes the ads. Nothing is locked behind a purchase. Coming soon to the App Store.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17 or later.
- Game types: Classic (one board, best time), Endless (boards keep coming), Beat the Clock (every find adds time, every miss costs time).
- Styles: Normal (a plain time trial), Competitive (points, combos and a multiplier up to ×3), Relax (effects without points).
- Boards: Numbers, Letters, Red & Black and Shifting, from 5 × 5 to 7 × 7 plus 9 × 9 and 11 × 11, counting up or down.
- Competitive scoring: 100 points per number plus a speed bonus of up to 50 that shrinks with time; ×2 from a combo of 5, ×3 from 15; the combo is lost when its timer runs out and halved by a wrong tap.
- Daily Challenge (14 rotating themes with goals) with streaks, ranks from Rookie to Legend, 539 achievements in 20 groups, 170 Game Center leaderboards (today, week, month, year, all time).
- Multiplayer: 1 v 1, 2 v 2 and group rooms (Race, Points battle, Knockout, Ghost race) on the same board for everyone, joined by code, QR code or link, with a nickname per game.
- Hints: a few a day; each adds 5 seconds. After every game, one sentence on the biggest improvement.
- Insights: blind spots on the board, time of day, rhythm and the most common mistakes.
- Seven looks (Classic, Focus, Neon Arcade, Zen Ink, Pit Lane, Candy Pop, Blossom) with matching app icons, a theme builder, and 42 sound styles.
- Accessibility: VoiceOver, Reduce Motion, Bold Text, Audio Graphs.
- Languages: English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean.
- Privacy: games stay on the device, no account. Anonymous usage statistics (TelemetryDeck, no names or game history) can be turned off in Settings. Game Center is optional. The free version shows ads from Google AdMob. The TestFlight beta is open to everyone: https://testflight.apple.com/join/G4XsUyyB. A waiting list for the App Store launch collects emails (sent through Web3Forms to the support inbox).
- Not a medical product: a game for practising focus.
- Support: contact49game@icloud.com (or https://github.com/49Game/49game.github.io/issues)
